pull.title: test: Wait for index sync in all tests
pull.body:
Fixes https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/36564 by adding the missing wait on the index sync.

Diff to reproduce:

```diff
diff --git a/src/util/thread.cpp b/src/util/thread.cpp
index 5b20e807b4..2e988c9eea 100644
--- a/src/util/thread.cpp
+++ b/src/util/thread.cpp
@@ -8,2 +8,3 @@
 #include <util/log.h>
+#include <util/time.h>
 #include <util/threadnames.h>
@@ -17,2 +18,3 @@ void util::TraceThread(std::string_view thread_name, std::function<void()> threa
     util::ThreadRename(std::string{thread_name});
+    UninterruptibleSleep(999ms);
     try {
```

Command to reproduce (run twice to create the cache the first time, and reproduce on the second):

```
./bld-cmake/test/functional/wallet_fast_rescan.py | grep WARNING
```


On failure, the log will say something like:

```
 - 2026-10-18T05:06:44.451973Z [http.01] [wallet/scan.cpp:142] [ShouldFetchBlock] [scan] Fast rescan: inspect block 200 [4c063a93914ec0cb1604297f2f601dab9b9342bf073e6b80e1c11efd71714e2e] (WARNING: block filter not found!)

test: refactor: Wait for index sync by default

The tests already wait for the mempool and blocks after start and after
mining, so they should wait for indexes as well to avoid intermittent
test failures.

This refactor does not change any test behavior.

events.body:
It seems a bit tedious to find and fix all of those issues by hand. Also, the tests will become overly verbose with all the manual syncs.

The framework should do this by itself, so I pushed that refactor and removed all of the manual syncs in tests.

Concept ACK, I like how cleaner it is.  I also measured performance but saw no significant change.

~~Commented a test that loses coverage with these changes.~~

> Diff to reproduce:...

I’m not sure this is the right reproducer, as all the tests pass on my Ubuntu 26.04 machine.

UPDATE. A bit unrelated to this PR, but that reproducer with a longer sleep triggered the following tests on my machine:
```
feature_anchors.py                                     | ✖ Failed  | 12 s
feature_config_args.py                                 | ✖ Failed  | 15 s
tool_utxo_to_sqlite.py                                 | ✖ Failed  | 3 s
```

UPDATE 2. Only `tool_utxo_to_sqlite.py` seems to have an issue, as others pass with the proper `--timeout-factor`.

UPDATE 3. A clanker's fix:
```diff
--- a/test/functional/tool_utxo_to_sqlite.py
+++ b/test/functional/tool_utxo_to_sqlite.py
@@ -119,6 +119,7 @@ class UtxoToSqliteTest(BitcoinTestFramework):
 
         self.log.info('Dump UTXO set via `dumptxoutset` RPC')
         input_filename = os.path.join(self.options.tmpdir, "utxos.dat")
+        self.wait_until(lambda: node.getindexinfo()['coinstatsindex']['synced'])
         node.dumptxoutset(input_filename, "latest")
 
         for i, (txid_format, spk_format) in enumerate(product(["hex", "raw", "rawle"], ["hex", "raw"])):
```

Sorry, I forgot to clarify this only reproduces when running the test stand-alone and on the second run, because it needs the cache.

comments.body:
In "test: refactor: Wait for index sync by default" fa74dc72d942e1628cea3c143bb56eed1457bbce

This changes test behavior. It used to check for absolute height and missing index.

I don't think it does change behavior. The implicit sync will use `getblockcount` as the absolute height, just like the test used the height before.

Also, the test calls RPCs to fetch the index data, so if an index was missing, the test would fail, just like before.
